prior_art_excluded: The general lifted exact-MSE operator and convex annealed-rate SDP of Agaskar, Wang and Lu (2014).
The one-step worst-case spectral SDP of Dai, Soltanalian and Pelckmans (2014).
The original exponential randomized Kaczmarz convergence bounds of Strohmer and Vershynin (2007).
scientific_integrity.verification: Analytic proof, supplemented by 789 finite exact-rational and deterministic geometry checks.

scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes finitely many nonzero real planar row vectors with rank two and a consistent system.
Independent identically distributed unrelaxed orthogonal-projection row sampling, with nonnegative probabilities including zero, is essential.
The rate is worst-initialization annealed mean-square decay; it does not determine the quenched exponent or adaptive-sampling performance.
An equivalent specialized planar solution may exist in older optimal-design literature; no independence or external certification is asserted.
title: Planar coincidence theorem for optimal randomized Kaczmarz sampling
